conventions.names: Component names are the names of the text. 'json' / 'xml' entries record where a binding uses another name or form.
conventions.validation: A component with 'validation': 'not-schema-based' is only placed by the model (where it may sit, how often); its content is checked by code ('validated_by'), not by the generated schemas.
conventions.binding_source: Every 'json' / 'xml' entry says where it comes from: 'from': 'forge-xsd' / 'forge-json' with 'forge' = the text found in the Forge schema (checked at build time), 'text' with a verified 'citation', or 'project' with a 'reason'.
conventions.occurrence: min/max per component; max 'n' = unbounded. 'items' describes a list component: the component itself holds a non-empty sequence of items.
conventions.content: sequence: components in order; choice: exactly one component; any-of: at least one component.
conventions.tie_break: Where the text contradicts itself, JSON follows the Forge JSON name and XML the Forge XML name.
conventions.constraints: Rules across components are 'constraint' entries on the structure they constrain, in the format of the profile overlays (FHIR invariant: key, severity, human, expression; plus clause, checkable and check). A constraint with a 'check' is enforced by the generated schemas; one without is a rules-layer requirement.
